tests.surface: TLS handshake sweep on :8743 + GET https://127.0.0.1:8743/
tests.weakness: Server negotiates deprecated TLSv1.0/TLSv1.1 and weak CBC-SHA1 / static-RSA (no PFS) cipher suites at SECLEVEL=0, presents an expired self-signed hostname-mismatched RSA-1024/SHA1 certificate, and sends no HSTS.
AES-CBC with fixed key/IV returns distinguishable errors (500 'Padding error' vs 400 'Invalid data'), enabling a full byte-by-byte padding-oracle decryption of the vault token.

tests.surface: POST http://127.0.0.1:8700/login, GET /api/account (Basic auth), TCP :8723, https://127.0.0.1:8743/
tests.weakness: Credentials, Basic-auth headers and API tokens cross plain HTTP/TCP; a TLS page submits its login form to an HTTP endpoint (mixed content) and session cookies lack the Secure flag.

Unsalted MD5 password hashes (reversible via precomputed lookup), AES-ECB revealing plaintext structure, static DES/RC4 keys decryptable to plaintext, and fixed-seed MT19937 reset tokens predictable via state clone.

Failures leak SQL queries, schema, DB path and tracebacks and give enumerable distinct responses; conversely /api/transfer swallows all exceptions and returns 200 'success' while the operation actually failed.

Unhandled exceptions in two stacks return full tracebacks with source paths, line numbers and framework internals; Werkzeug's interactive debugger (PIN-protected console) is exposed and Express runs in development mode.
